notes: The flagged two-morpheme unit אִישׁ מַשְׁחִית → *a destroyer* is retained: a generic head noun before an attributive naming the class, rendered by one English word, fuses under rule 30 and heads on the morpheme carrying the lexeme; the indefinite article is the nominal expression's own under rule 15.
The existential אַיִן keeps its supplied dummy and copula and heads on *no* (rule 50).
